About

Lastrio is a marketplace that turns verified carbon-removal projects, from biochar to reforestation, into blockchain tokens, one per tonne removed, that anyone can buy, hold or trade. Projects pay a monthly listing fee to issue their tokens. Next, it will add trading fees and launch its own platform token, starting with a token pre-sale in this round.
